It appends a CHANGELOG.md entry headed with a date and work-item 04, one line per term, giving the reason Usage_Digest was chosen over Weekly Report. It creates no context-map.md and no canvas, sets no term to agreed, and hands over to sdd:spec-generator.
criteria: Asks no question, because the prompt gives name, definition, words to avoid and context for both terms
Adds ### Usage_Digest and ### Account_Admin entries with the given definitions and Avoid lists

Leaves every existing glossary entry unchanged and keeps the entries in alphabetical order

Creates no context-map.md and no canvas.md
Hands over to sdd:spec-generator for project/work-items/04-usage-digest/ (naming it as the next step counts, including when the run says the skill is not available in its session)
